records.statement: Japan's SME Investment & Consultation system has three official regional sister companies: Tokyo/SBIC East Japan, Osaka/SBIC West Japan and Nagoya/SBIC Central Japan. The exact entity intended by the user's original 'Japan's SBIC' phrase cannot be selected without its original source context. Earlier Tokyo-only resolution was incomplete.

Official East and West SBIC materials document ChatGPT education/seminars. They do not establish an OpenAI partnership, SBI Group investment, XRP/crypto exposure or exclusive relationship with one regional SBIC.

Exact-name YouTube searches did not identify a verified Camilla Stephenson channel. IMDb and LinkedIn results show same-name professional profiles in different fields, but no evidence links them to each other or to a YouTube channel. An exhaustive video inventory is not established.

The exact originating context for the phrase 'actual capital' remains unresolved. Market capitalization, gross stablecoin transfer volume, ETF flows, net external capital and executed XRP purchases must remain separate measurements.
